data.name: Calley
data.gender_notes: Calley is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'calix', meaning 'cup' or 'vessel'. In Christian symbolism, the chalice represents the vessel used to hold the Eucharist during Mass. Calley embodies the idea of being a beautiful and faithful vessel, carrying the love and grace of God. The name Calley carries the meaning “Beautiful vessel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Calley usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful vessel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beautiful vessel for the divine
data.etymology: Calley belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful vessel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Calley total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קאלי
in_hebrew.meaning: קול ה', צורה יפה, שיר ה'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאלי נגזר מהמילה העברית 'קול', שפירושה קול או קול ה'. הוא קשור גם למילה 'צורה', שפירושה צורה או יופי. השם קאלי משמש גם ככינוי לשיר ה' או לקול של אלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש במסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד.

in_greek.name: Καλή
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καλή προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για 'καλή' ή 'ωραία'. Είναι επίσης συνδεδεμένο με τη λέξη 'αγάπη', που σημαίνει αγάπη ή έρωτας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας Ορθοδόξου, το όνομα Καλή έχει συσχετιστεί με την έννοια της πνευματικής ομορφιάς και της αγάπης προς τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Calley
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Calley derivatur a latino 'vox', significans vocem vel Vox Domini. Est etiam coniunctum cum 'forma', quod significat formam seu pulchritudinem. In traditione christiana, nomen Calley adhibetur ad designandam vocem Dei seu pulchritudinem spiritualem.

in_english.name: Calley
in_english.meaning: Beautiful voice, lovely, God is my strength
in_english.long_meaning: The name Calley originates from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying a beautiful voice or lovely. It is associated with the concept of spiritual beauty and strength. In Christian tradition, Calley is used to denote a person with a strong faith and a beautiful soul. The name has been in use across various Christian cultures, symbolizing a connection to divine beauty and strength.

data.spiritual_significance: Calley represents the idea of being a faithful and beautiful vessel used to carry and hold the love, grace, and blessings of God. In Christian beliefs, the Eucharist is a representation of the body and blood of Jesus Christ. Just as the chalice holds this precious substance during Mass, individuals who bear the name Calley are encouraged to be a vessel of love and joy, filled with the grace of God and sharing it with others. This name is a constant reminder to live a life worthy of the divine, spreading God's love and blessings to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Calley is derived from the Hebrew name "Calev," meaning "strong, brave, or whole-hearted." In the Christian context, it symbolizes the courage and devotion of a faithful follower of God, ready to face challenges with strength and unwavering faith.
